content.test_md_blob:
# Open the in-page security modal from the preview

> Prove OPEN SECURITY in the preview opens the in-page modal and the modal shows the required security detail sections.

## Step 1

Open {{dashboard_url}} and wait until the dashboard page with the Top Holdings card is fully visible.

## Step 2

Capture baseline: no security modal is open on the dashboard.

## Step 3

In the Top Holdings card, explicitly activate the NVDA ticker to open its security preview popover.

## Step 4

From the NVDA security preview popover, activate OPEN SECURITY.

## Step 5

Assert that an in-page security modal is now visible and that it shows security name, ticker, price, daily move, chart, fundamentals, analyst consensus, and recent news.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-61, ac-62

Confirm state-transition check: security modal open (equals) — the stated promise: Activating OPEN SECURITY from the preview opens an in-page security modal.
